feature: Popup control center, usage and cost metering, options auto-save and diagnostics
deliverables: host ping in protly_host.py + transport.ping + diag/testCall handlers
success_criteria: 10 concurrent usage records yield calls=10 with no lost tokens
days older than 62 are pruned; unknown model gives unpriced=true
ping reply never contains the key and never calls urlopen
a site switched off mounts nothing on the next load
testable_behaviors: Check host shows Host OK, key found, workspace header on
Test call shows model and ms and adds a usage entry for today
popup shows switches, tab status and Today/This month cost
Gmail off: no Translate button after reload, popup says Gmail: off
a tab with the ! badge shows Problem: <reason>
scope_boundaries: no Alt+T, routing, context menu or generic bundle (Sprint 4)
site switches apply on reload only
no history beyond today and this month
evaluation_method: unit + live check in Chrome (Claude drives extension pages; the user checks the toolbar popup)
